name: automacao-fake-store-api
description: Testes automatizados de API para a Fake Store API com Cypress.
author: Gabriela Ambos

scripts.report: mochawesome-merge "cypress/report/mochawesome-report/*.json" > cypress/report/merged.json && marge cypress/report/merged.json --reportDir cypress/report/site --reportFilename index --reportTitle "Fake Store API — Execution Report" --reportPageTitle "Fake Store API — Execution Report" --charts --inline
scripts.report:publish: gh-pages --dist cypress/report/site --branch gh-pages --message "chore: publish execution report"
